about_the_game:
Federal Bureau of Anomalies (FBA)

Since the early days of the Cold War, the Federal Bureau of Anomalies (FBA) has operated as one of the U.S. government's most secretive agencies. Its mission: to investigate, contain, and eliminate anomalous phenomena across the country. These include extraterrestrial incursions, interdimensional rifts, psychic infections, non-human entities, awakened ancient relics, and unauthorized uses of supernatural technology.

The FBA is known for fast, silent operations that leave no evidence behind. Their motto: "No explanations. No records. No witnesses." Agents are drawn from military, scientific, and intelligence backgrounds, trained to remain calm in situations that defy logic and reality. As anomalous events continue to escalate, the FBA has established covert bases across the country. To the public, it doesn't exist. But you are now one of them.

Current Operation – Case File WX-AE-1999

Location: Nevada Desert, Southwestern United States
Assigned Agent: FBA-009 · Aiden Cross
Mission Type: Class-A Recon and Elimination (Red Threat Protocol active)

Unofficial reports describe giant, eye-like creatures appearing near an abandoned industrial facility. Witnesses also experienced severe electromagnetic interference and psychological stress. The anomaly is active and potentially hostile.

Agent Cross has been dispatched under Level-One Containment Protocol. All hostile entities are authorized for elimination. Tactical data and gear systems are syncing in real time.

Stay calm. Stay focused. Erase the anomaly.

Game Features

Classic rail shooter action with a modern edge
Inspired by old-school arcade shooters, this game brings fast-paced first-person combat into a fully realized 3D environment with immersive visuals and tight controls.

Intense, cinematic combat sequences
Battle a variety of grotesque and aggressive enemies in high-pressure scenarios designed to keep you on edge from beginning to end.

A dark, unfolding narrative
Through mission briefings, radio transmissions, and in-game events, you’ll uncover the truth behind the anomaly—and what the FBA isn’t telling you.

The unknown is your true enemy
Beyond the firefights lies something deeper. An atmosphere of dread. Psychological strain. And a growing sense that nothing about this mission is what it seems.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains a lot of blood and dismemberment for killing enemies and a little nudity

name: Blood Storm: Alien Purge
short_description: In this intense first-person rail shooter, you play as Aiden Cross, an agent of the Federal Bureau of Anomalies (FBA). Sent to investigate alien sightings at a remote desert facility in Nevada, what began as a routine mission quickly spirals into a deadly battle against unknown creatures...
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
